meta.title: Zürich study spaces dataset

schema_notes.kind: university | public_library | company | coworking | niche | cafe
schema_notes.access.who: public | students | eth (ETH card works) | uzh (UZH card only) | members
schema_notes.hours: weekly map mon..sun -> list of [open, close] in Europe/Zurich local time; empty = closed or unknown (see hours_note)
schema_notes.occupancy.source: eth-api (5-min traffic light per room) | zb-counter (reading-room % on ZB homepage) | uzh-ub-live (UB page widget) | none
schema_notes.verification.status: verified (all key fields from an official source on the check date) | partly (some fields unverified, listed) | unverified (only listed by a secondary source)
schema_notes.vibe: free tags used for mood matching: focus, social, cozy, green, view, historic, architecture, central, local, creative, perks, hidden-gem
schema_notes.coord_precision: address (geocoded from street address via OpenStreetMap Nominatim) | approx

meta.licences: Place facts compiled from the sources listed per entry. Coordinates © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Photos: see each photo's credit and licence.

places.name: Bibliothek der PH Zürich

access.summary: Open to external visitors on weekdays; Saturdays PHZH members only.

places.hours_note: Opening hours not stated on the page read; info desk Mon–Fri 10–13 and 14–17. Saturdays only with a PHZH Campus-Card.

booking.note: Individual and group workspaces on campus.

sources.label: Tsüri: Studierende kämpfen um die Arbeitsplätze (PH sample: ~150 seats, ~40 free mornings in June)

places.notes: Two minutes from Zürich HB. In a June sample about 40 of ~150 seats were still free in the morning, so a good overflow when the ZB is full.

places.name: Zentralbibliothek Zürich (ZB)

access.summary: Open to everyone. Quiet floors P1 to P3 without reservation; group rooms need a library account.

places.hours_note: Sunday: reading room only.

booking.note: Seats: no reservation. Group rooms (2–6 people, max 4 h/day) and call boxes bookable up to 14 days ahead.

occupancy.note: Live people counter for the reading rooms on the ZB homepage, refreshed every 10 min.

sources.label: Blick: queues at Zurich libraries in exam season

places.notes: Around 600 public workspaces, 220 rentable lockers. Queues before opening are common in exam season.

places.name: Büro Züri (Zürcher Kantonalbank)

access.summary: Free workspaces for individuals and teams for several hours; aimed at start-ups, students and founders.

places.hours_note: Opening hours not stated on the ZKB page; check when reserving.

booking.note: Reserve online, free of charge.

sources.label: 20 Minuten (2016): 21 free desks, almost always booked
Ron Orp: 23 Lernorte in Zürich (9 Nov 2026)

places.notes: Networking events too, so expect some buzz.

places.name: Siemens StudyHub

access.summary: Free for students with a valid physical Legi. Day booking online; ring at reception.

places.hours_note: January 2026 edition: 5–30 Jan, 08:00–17:30. A January 2027 edition is not yet confirmed.

booking.note: Single desks per day; group rooms (5–10 people) per morning or afternoon. Over 1000 bookings in Jan 2026, single desks sold out.

places.notes: Free Wi-Fi, coffee, drinks and snacks (Valora). Weekly career sessions with Siemens HR. Tram stop 'Siemens', 4 min walk.

places.name: Citizen Space Zürich

access.summary: Paid coworking: day ticket CHF 29, 10-day pass CHF 300.

places.hours_note: Members have 24/7 access; day-ticket hours not stated.

booking.note: Book a daily ticket online; trial day on request.

places.notes: Quiet coworking with height-adjustable desks. Paid, but a fallback when everything free is full.

places.name: Impact Hub Colab and Café Auer & Co.

access.summary: Paid coworking (day pass); café open to everyone.

places.hours_note: Day pass covers 08:30–17:30. Café hours not checked.

booking.note: Trial day CHF 10; memberships from CHF 45/month. Regular day-pass price not checked.

sources.label: Impact Hub Zürich: coworking day pass
Ron Orp: 23 Lernorte in Zürich (9 Nov 2026)
